title: Fountain plaza at the map's scale
caption: The plaza rebuilt from the island layout: the 23-across round plaza, an 8.6-across fountain with water and coins, the two-storey canteen and its umbrella terrace, the lane along the plaza's south edge, and after dark the lamps, the canteen and the town windows lit. Walk east from the forecourt to see it (or ?place=plaza).

sections.title: Before
sections.caption: The old chunk: 14.6 wide, a 3-across basin, a one-storey canteen box and one row of shop roofs.

images.caption: On the island map: the whole chunk fit inside the map's plaza

sections.title: Arriving
sections.caption: Coming from the forecourt he lands on the lane just south-west of the fountain, so the phone view shows it.
